page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a thread-per-core ratio of 1.0, each of the 96 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention typically associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated physical cores, this instance represents a high-density resource profile. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs focuses its cost efficiency on memory-bound and CPU-intensive workloads that rely on network-attached storage. It is configured for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, memory-intensive data analytics, and high-performance computing tasks requiring dedicated CPU execution.
